KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft. Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen. Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus Was uns wichtig ist Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich. Das bekommst Du Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest. raw.title: Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Job description

We are building modern, customer-facing software for the temp-staffing industry, integrating capabilities from multiple ERP systems and countries into reliable applications, workflows, services, and reusable platform components.

We are looking for a product-minded senior fullstack engineer who can turn ambiguous business requirements and complex existing systems into production-grade backend services, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and intuitive user interfaces.

TypeScript is central to our technology landscape. Experience with .NET and C# is strongly valued, while engineers with a background in strongly typed languages such as Java are also welcome. Comfort working across different stacks and languages is essential.

AI and LLM tooling are central to how we work. You should use AI-native workflows to explore faster, build in parallel, validate assumptions, and ship high-quality production solutions. You should care about correctness and maintainability, understand integration and business edge cases, choose simple and robust solutions, and own outcomes from exploration to production.


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
  • Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
  • Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
  • Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
  • Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability


Your profile

  • Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
  • Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
  • Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
  • Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
  • Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
  • Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs
  • Understands deployment, secrets, networking, permissions, runtime configuration, scalability, performance, cost, and operational trade-offs
You may be a good fit if you are driven to improve how software is built, use AI and agent-based workflows to move faster, experiment with better approaches, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable production solutions. You should enjoy working across the stack, taking ownership beyond predefined tickets, improving existing systems, and rigorously validating AI-generated output rather than accepting it at face value. This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Flexible working models including hybrid work, home office, and mobile working
  • A modern tech environment and agile ways of working
  • Additional benefits such as pension plans, health offers, and employee discounts


I look forward to receiving your application

Svenja Krüßel
D-49835 Wietmarschen-Lohne
Tel.: 0170-7888740

description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>Über die Position</strong></p> <p>Als&nbsp;<strong>Account Executive Commercial</strong> <strong>(Public)</strong> bist du dafür verantwortlich, in deinem zugewiesenen Markt Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im öffentlichen Sektort zu entwickeln und erfolgreich abzuschließen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Partnervertrieb. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Identifikation, Entwicklung und Beschleunigung von Vertriebschancen gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sowie auf der erfolgreichen Realisierung von Abschlüssen und Up- und Cross-Selling-Potenzialen.</p> <h4>Dein Tätigkeitsfeld</h4> <ul> <li>Entwicklung und erfolgreicher Abschluss von Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit definierten Kunden im öffentlichen Sektor</li> <li>Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Vertriebsabschlüssen bei deren Endkunden</li> <li>Aktive Neukundenansprache, einschließlich Kaltakquise, zur Entwicklung von Vertriebsaktivitäten mit einer Vielzahl neuer Endkunden im Mid-Market- und gehobenen Kundensegment</li> <li>Identifikation und Umsetzung von Up-Selling- und Cross-Selling-Potenzialen innerhalb des bestehenden Kundenstamms</li> <li>Pflege von Forecasts sowie Account- und Opportunity-Informationen in Salesforce</li> <li>Vorschlag, Koordination und Teilnahme an Marketingaktivitäten im definierten Vertriebsgebiet</li> </ul> <h4><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">Dein Profil</span></h4> <ul> <li>Erfahrung im direkten Vertrieb und in der Neukundengewinnung</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Anbietern aus den Bereichen Virtualisierung, Cloud und SaaS ist von Vorteil</li> <li>Erfahrung im Vertrieb über Partnerkanäle sowie im Direktvertrieb</li> <li>Nachweisbare Erfolge im Vertrieb an IT-Infrastruktur-Spezialisten</li> <li>Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, neue Vertriebschancen zu entwickeln</li> <li>Eigeninitiative sowie die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten</li> <li>Hohe Motivation, Energie und Abschlussorientierung im Vertrieb</li> <li>Freude an einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten schnell verändern können</li> <li>Reisebereitschaft von mindestens 50 %</li> <li>Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B</li> <li>Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse</li> </ul> <h4>Unsere Benefits:</h4> <ul> <li>Umfassende finanzielle Absicherung&nbsp;– Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Lebensversicherung und Unfallversicherung zum Schutz für Sie und Ihre Familie</li> <li>Großzügige title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) – Remote oder Berlin
description: Overview PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern. Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft . Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr. Bist du dabei? Deine Rolle Strategisch und themensicher: Du entwickelst individuelle PR Strategien für Kunden aus dem B2B- und B2C-Bereich – mit klarem Fokus auf Themenplatzierung in relevanten Medien. Dabei bringst du journalistisches Denken und strategische Kommunikation zusammen. Beratend auf Augenhöhe: Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit deinen Kund*innen professionell, planst vorausschauend (z. B. mit Quartalsplänen & KPIs) und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du bringst proaktiv Themen ein – und entwickelst die Kommunikation deiner Kund*innen kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Sparringspartner*in auf C-Level-Augenhöhe, nicht Auftragsempfänger*in. Teamorientiert & offen: Du teilst dein Wissen, gibst und nimmst Peer-to-Peer-Feedback über alle Erfahrungslevel hinweg, ohne Gatekeeping, mit echtem Interesse an gemeinsamer Weiterentwicklung. Vorne auf der AI Welle: Du arbeitest aktiv mit unserem internen AI-Stack. Recherche, Pitch-Vorbereitung, Themen-Scouting – wo Maschinen schneller sind, lassen wir sie machen. Du investierst die gewonnene Zeit in Substanz, Beziehungen und Kreativität. Aktives Netzwerken: Du baust und pflegst belastbare Beziehungen zu Journalist*innen aus den wichtigsten Medien im DACH Raum und Europas. Wer du bist 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast Kund*innen nachweislich eigenständig in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. Du bringst fundierte Beratungskompetenz mit, analysierst Zielgruppen und Märkte, übersetzt Unternehmensziele in PR Strategien, leitest messbare Maßnahmen ab und begleitest deine Kund*innen als verlässliche* Sparringspartner*in auf Augenhöhe. Du hast ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen und weißt, wie man vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbaut und pflegt. Du beobachtest die Nachrichtenlage aktiv und erkennst Themenpotenziale, bevor andere sie auf dem Schirm haben. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst dich ins Team ein und teilst dein Wissen offen. Du nutzt KI-Tools pragmatisch, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen, damit mehr Zeit für inhaltliche Tiefe und kreative Ideen bleibt. Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2- Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland Was dich erwartet Journalistische PR statt Massenversand: Bei uns gibt es keine generischen Pressemitteilungen oder Gießkannenverteiler. Wir arbeiten individuell, redaktionell und mit klarer Themenstrategie und pitchen gezielt per Telefon bei passenden Journalist*innen aus einem breiten Medienspektrum. Langfristige Perspektive & Entwicklung: Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir einen klaren Fahrplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung – mit regelmäßigen Feedbacks und transparenten Zielen. Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote, hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Entscheidungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und klare Kommunikation gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. Unterstützung und offene Arme: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. Eine Kultur von Challengern. Wir arbeiten ergebnisgetrieben, feiern Erfolge und erwarten, dass du uns challenged – und wir challengen zurück. Augenhöhe heißt bei uns: ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. Eine Lernkurve, die du anderswo nicht bekommst. Du arbeitest täglich mit einem Team, das das fortschrittlichste AI PR System im Markt baut. Wer sich jetzt einbringt, baut sich ein Profil, das in der Branche selten ist. Benefits und Sweet Treats: Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren,180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu. Unser nächsten Schritte Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!’’ , dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams! Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Behinderung. Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen! Dein People & Culture Team Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.</p> <p>Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <p>You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.</p> <p>Here's what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li>Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.</li> <li>Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.</li> <li>Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.</li> <li>Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Thrive</strong></p> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:</p> <ul> <li>Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.</li> <li>You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.</li> <li>You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.</li> <li>You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.</li> <li>You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.</li> <li>You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.</li> <li>You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).</li> <li>You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p>The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Augmented Software Engineer [gn] Data Intelligence Platform based in Germany.

This is an opportunity for a full-stack engineer to help build a modern data intelligence platform that enables organisations to discover, govern, and trust their data.
You’ll work end-to-end across backend services and frontend experiences, taking features from initial concept through production delivery.
AI coding assistants will be a core part of your engineering toolkit, helping you accelerate development while keeping human judgment at the center of technical decisions.
You’ll contribute to scalable SaaS products where correctness, security, performance, and maintainability are critical.
The role offers significant autonomy, encouraging you to identify problems, shape solutions, and move initiatives forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
You’ll collaborate closely with product managers and engineers in an agile, feedback-driven environment focused on continuous improvement.
It’s an ideal setting for a pragmatic builder who wants to multiply their engineering impact through thoughtful use of AI.


Accountabilities
  • Design and implement full-stack product features across backend services and frontend interfaces, ensuring strong performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of features from understanding requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools deliberately to accelerate development, reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, improve test coverage, and increase engineering leverage.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when using AI-generated output, reviewing, validating, and improving solutions rather than relying on automation without oversight.
  • Participate actively in technical design discussions and code reviews, promoting clean architecture, secure development practices, and testable code.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and participate in incident response, taking shared responsibility for the stability and reliability of the platform.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand customer and business requirements early and translate them into clear, achievable technical solutions.
  • Share technical knowledge with colleagues through documentation, technical sessions, and internal development practices.
  • Help establish and improve AI-assisted engineering practices, contributing reusable approaches, workflows, and lessons learned across the team.
  • Contribute to an agile working environment based on short feedback loops, iterative delivery, collaboration, and continuous learning.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven professional experience as a full-stack software engineer, with a track record of independently building and shipping production features in SaaS environments.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools as an integrated part of your development workflow.
    • Strong engineering judgment and the ability to recognize when AI-generated solutions are useful, incomplete, misleading, or require deeper human analysis.
    • Practical experience with Scala or Java on the backend and TypeScript and Angular on the frontend is highly valuable; expertise across every technology is not required, but you should be willing and able to grow across the stack.
    • Solid understanding of SaaS architecture and cloud fundamentals, particularly within AWS environments.
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including clean architecture, testing, maintainability, performance, and secure development.
    • A genuine agile mindset, with a preference for iterative delivery, rapid feedback, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
    • Strong product thinking and the ability to translate business and user requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
    • Comfortable working with autonomy, taking initiative, and driving work forward without requiring every task to be explicitly assigned.
    • Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills within collaborative engineering teams.
    • Full professional proficiency in English.
    • Experience with data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, or data intelligence platforms is a significant advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
      • Flexible working arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
      • Opportunity to work on an innovative data intelligence platform with real-world enterprise impact.
      • Exposure to AI-assisted software engineering and the opportunity to help shape modern development practices.
      • High level of autonomy and ownership in a builder-oriented environment.
      • Collaboration with a passionate, diverse, and internationally minded engineering team.
      • Opportunities for professional growth, technical development, and continuous learning.
      • Agile, collaborative culture focused on outcomes, experimentation, and short feedback loops.
      • Inclusive working environment where qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of background or identity.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. About the team The Credit Risk team is part of Airwallex’s Second Line of Defence and helps the company grow responsibly as a global financial platform. We work at the intersection of credit, FX, and counterparty risk, partnering closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal to enable commercial growth while protecting Airwallex from financial loss and excessive risk exposure. This is a team for analytical, commercially minded risk leaders who are energized by building scalable frameworks and practical controls across a fast-moving, multi-currency global network. What you'll do As Director, Credit Risk, you will lead Airwallex's global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk. You will set the risk guardrails that allow the business to grow safely across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Financial Risk, you will own the global framework, risk appetite, limits, governance, and portfolio oversight for these risk areas. You will provide independent challenge to first-line decisions and act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across the business. This role is based in London. Responsibilities Credit risk framework and risk appetite: Define, implement, and continuously enhance the global second-line credit risk framework, including policies, risk appetite thresholds, limits, escalation protocols, and governance standards across Airwallex’s products and legal entities. Credit portfolio oversight: Oversee credit exposures across merchant acquiring, charge cards, B2B and commercial activities, FX pre-funding, treasury-related exposures, settlement flows, and other relevant products. Underwriting and limit governance: Review and challenge first-line underwriting strategies, customer and merchant risk policies, credit assessments, limit-setting methodologies, and exception processes. Act as a senior escalation point for complex or high-value credit decisions. FX risk oversight: Establish and monitor appropriate second-line guardrails for FX exposures arising from pre-funding, settlement, customer activity, treasury flows, and other multi-currency activities. Challenge controls, limits, escalation triggers, and risk reporting to ensure exposures remain within approved tolerances. Counterparty risk management: Set and oversee counterparty risk standards for banking partners, payment partners, merchants, customers, and other material counterparties. Establish appropriate exposure limits, concentration thresholds, monitoring requirements, and escalation processes. Portfolio monitoring and early warning indicators: Lead proactive monitoring of credit, FX, and counterparty portfolios, including exposure, concentration, delinquency, default, chargeback, loss, settlement, liquidity-of-counterparty, and other relevant risk indicators. Identify emerging trends and escalate material issues before they become systemic. Loss mitigation and remediation: Review and challenge first-line monitoring, collections, collateral, prefunding, reserves, chargeback, and other mitigation strategies. Ensure deteriorating counterparties, customers, merchants, or exposures are identified and addressed promptly. New products and market expansion: Partner with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Treasury, Finance, and Operations to assess and challenge the risk design of new products, features, markets, currencies, and partner arrangements before launch. Risk approvals and governance: Lead or support risk committee decisions, material risk approvals, limit exceptions, breach assessments, and remediation plans. Ensure decisions are documented clearly and aligned with approved risk appetite. Regulatory and partner engagement: Represent Credit Risk during regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, and reviews with banking and strategic partners. Prepare clear, decision-useful materials for senior management, risk committees, and the Board where appropriate. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. Deep experience designing, implementing, and governing second-line credit risk frameworks in a complex, multi-jurisdictional organization. Strong understanding of credit risk identification, measurement, underwriting, limit management, monitoring, mitigation, provisioning, loss recognition, and capital implications. Demonstrated experience managing risk across multiple product lines, such as merchant acquiring, commercial or charge cards, B2B lending, payment processing, FX, treasury, settlement, or banking-partner activities. Practical experience overseeing FX and counterparty risk, including exposure measurement, concentration risk, limits, settlement risk, prefunding, collateral or other mitigants, and escalation governance. Proven ability to challenge first-line decisions and communicate clear risk positions to senior executives, commercial leaders, product and operations teams, banking partners, auditors, and regulators. Preferred qualifications Advanced degree such as an MBA or Master's in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field. Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CFA, or an equivalent qualification. Experience with automated decisioning engines, credit scoring models, portfolio analytics, or alternative data used in underwriting and monitoring. Familiarity with IFRS 9, expected credit loss methodologies, stress testing, or other relevant prudential and accounting frameworks. Strong data literacy and familiarity with SQL, Python, or similar tools used to analyze portfolio, exposure, and loss trends. Experience working in a regulated payments fintech, digital bank, or financial institution with multiple licenses and banking partnerships. title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. About MoonPay Enterprise MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes. KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome. What You'll Own KYB product strategy & roadmap Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners. Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation. MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order. Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation. Onboarding funnel & conversion The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step. Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both. Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on. KYB API & partner experience The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once). Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it. Compliance as product Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix. EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product. Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy. Vendor & provider orchestration The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it. Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place. Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk. Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone. Who You Are A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature. High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it. Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction. AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team. Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy. You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification. At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers. You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build. A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped. Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for.   NYC Salary: $217,000 - $279,000 Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. Benefits & Perks 💡 💰 Competitive salary package 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 10 employees twice a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership 🤖 Unlimited enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons 🚲 (Ireland) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit 🔌 (UK) EV Salary Sacrifice: lease an electric vehicle through pre-tax salary   Commitment to Diversity At MoonPay we believe that every voice matters. We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, and experience a culture that is free of harassment, racism, and discrimination. That's why we are committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and are a proud equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including, but not limited to, hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, and leave of absence. MoonPay is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our job application procedures for qualified individuals with disabilities. Please inform our Talent Team if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process. title: Payroll Manager
description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

You'll play a key role in fostering a supportive, solution-driven workplace culture.

  • Provide white-glove IT support services to executive team members, ensuring rapid resolution and seamless experience for critical business operations

  • Administer access management via Okta and terraform to ensure secure, seamless employee onboarding and daily operations

  • Champion the IT employee lifecycle, driving memorable onboarding experiences for new starters and smooth offboardings

  • Optimize office network connectivity and audio/visual hardware across meeting rooms and workstations to enable effortless collaboration

title: Senior HRBP & Strategic Projects Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>UK-based HR leader who will serve as the primary HR Business Partner for our UK organisation as well as driving strategic, HRBP led global initiatives.</p> <p>This person will be a key member of the UK leadership team, the main HR partner supporting the Head of International, and the voice of UK employees in all people-related matters. They will lead talent management, performance, and organisational effectiveness efforts in the UK. In addition, the role will own strategic HRBP projects that improve processes, enhance engagement, and support effective decision-making across the HRBP function.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has a minimum of 5 years of HRBP specific business partner experience, exceptional stakeholder management, strong analytical skillset and the ability to deliver both in-the-moment guidance and long-term impact.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Senior HRBP</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Talent &amp; Leadership Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary HRBP for the UK, partnering closely with the Head of International and the UK leadership team to provide coaching and guidance on organisational health, talent planning, workforce strategy, and manager capability.</li> <li>Act as the voice of the UK in people decisions, ensuring regional context and needs are incorporated into strategy, processes, and programs.</li> <li>Partner with leaders to drive effective talent management, including performance cycles, career development, promotions, organisational design, and succession planning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Employee Relations &amp; Performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end employee relations matters for the UK, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant processes.</li> <li>Provide coaching to managers and employees to promote a culture of accountability, empathy, and high performance.</li> <li>Support performance management cases, development plans, and escalations with sound judgment and discretion.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Culture, Communications &amp; Change</strong></p> <ul> <li>Champion Faire’s culture within the UK, ensuring strong communication, engagement, and alignment across teams.</li> <li>Partner on engagement survey action planning and retention initiatives across International</li> <li>Guide leaders and employees through organisational change, delivering clear communication plans and supporting effective adoption.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data-Driven People Insights</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leverage people data and insights to influence decision-making, identify trends, and proactively address organisational risks or opportunities.</li> <li>Maintain strong HR governance, ensuring documentation, compliance, and internal processes are followed appropriately.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Day-to-Day Local HR Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own day-to-day UK HR operational needs in partnership with the broader People Operations and HR Centers of Excellence teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Advise on UK-specific requirements for HR programs across immigration, benefits, leaves and accommodations.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Strategic Projects Lead</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Strategic People Programs</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the Head of HRBPs and broader HRBP team on strategic initiatives including OKR tracking, ongoing retention and org design activities, updates to performance process and philosophy and manager education materials as well as acting as the voice of the HRBP team on change management projects that span across various teams.</li> <li>Lead Project management for cross functional initiatives as required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI &amp; Tooling Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Stay closely informed on the evolution of AI and emerging HR/People-tech tooling in the market.</li> <li>Regularly experiment with new AI tools and technologies to identify opportunities that improve HRBP workflows, enhance manager enablement, or streamline people processes.</li> <li>Partner on the launch of new AI tools globally with key x-functional teams, including developing rollout plans and gathering feedback.</li> <li>Partner with key internal teams to influence product/tooling roadmaps and ensure solutions are aligned to business needs and scalable for the UK and broader International organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proactively identify opportunities to streamline HRBP workflows, strengthen manager enablement, and enhance how people processes operate globally.</li> <li>Ensure key trackers are updated, maintained, and optimised for usability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 5y+ of HRBP specific experience supporting senior leaders and influencing strategic decisions</li> <li>UK employment law expertise</li> <li>Understanding of HR practices across performance, talent management, employee relations, and organisational design</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and communicate people data effectively</li> <li>Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across all levels</li> <li>Proven experience in driving cross functional projects&nbsp;</li> <li>High empathy with the ability to balance employee experience and business needs</li> <li>Excellent judgment and discretion in handling sensitive matters</li> <li>Proven AI fluency</li> <li>Flexibility to work across multiple timezones</li> <li>[Nice to have] Experience supporting international or multi-region teams</li> <li>[Nice to have] Familiarity with high-growth tech, marketplaces, or startup environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range</strong></p> <p>UK London: The pay range for this role is £75,000 and £103,500 per year&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.&nbsp;<br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.</li> </ul> <p>Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our <a href="https://blog.faire.com/">blog</a>.</p> <p></p> <p>Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.</p> <p>Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.&nbsp; To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSczpI9me7nYKhunSC6AlagHKv75LHqfi-Qi2TP_3dpin0Uc9Q/viewform">Accommodation Request Form</a> (<a href="https://bit.ly/faire-form)">https://bit.ly/faire-form)</a></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Privacy</strong></p> <p>For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s <a class="c-link" href="https://www.faire.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.faire.com/privacy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer - Reference Data - AI/ML (UK)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.&nbsp;</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>We are currently seeking a Staff Software Engineer with AI/ML background to join our Reference Data team.</p> <p>The reference data team at Addepar is responsible to manage the data reconciliation and curation process for market data providers to build a single source of truth and provide alignment across public and alternative investment data products for the client to manage their investment portfolio.</p> <p>As an engineer on the team you will partner with product teams at Addepar to understand their business needs. The team is focused on enabling and building disruptive, innovative solutions to transform the wealth technology landscape with AI across our product suite and is growing quickly.</p> <p>You will be responsible for architecting, leading, and driving the execution of the core AI capabilities that power our platform. This is a high-impact role for an engineer who thrives on the frontier of applied AI and maintains a relentless focus on shipping. You will not just work with LLMs and agentic frameworks; you will own the end-to-end delivery of AI-native products, ensuring that cutting-edge AI systems are hardened into robust, scalable, and high-performance production systems.</p> <p>Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Drive the end-to-end execution and delivery of AI-native products, moving from initial prototype to scalable production services with high velocity</li> <li>Architect, build, and productionize core components of our AI platform – including:</li> <ul> <li>LLMs and the surrounding ecosystem (e.g., vector DBs, prompt tuning, etc.)</li> <li>Agentic frameworks</li> <li>Core agent capabilities like MCP/ cross-platform tool use, web browsing, computer use</li> </ul> <li>Enforce technical discipline and operational excellence for all of our AI products</li> <li>Rapidly iterate on AI products based on performance metrics and user feedback to drive continuous improvement</li> <li>Lead the evaluation and adoption of new AI technologies and frameworks to keep Addepar on the frontier of the industry</li> <li>Partner with product managers and other engineering teams to translate strategic goals into technical realities, abstracting AI complexity so they can iterate quickly</li> <li>Collaborate closely with our engineering leads to define and implement our platform architecture to meet Addepar’s growth and scalability needs&nbsp;</li> <li>Evaluate and drive strategic business and technology decisions for the company and for customers</li> <li>Be a technical thought leader in multiple areas who educates and shares best practices. Your contributions deliver strategic and prescriptive guidance</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>B.S., or M.S. in Computer Science or similar technical field of study (or equivalent practical experience)</li> <li>Extensive software engineering experience</li> <li>Proven track record of owning and shipping complex, production-grade systems.</li> <li>Proven experience shipping and maintaining AI-native products or features, or demonstrable passion through significant personal projects in AI</li> <li>Deep ownership mindset, seeing projects through to completion and raising the bar for execution across the team</li> <li>A strong bias for action, with a passion for shipping rapidly and iterating with feedback</li> <li>BS/MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>[Preferred] Specific experience with LLMs and agentic systems</li> <li>[Preferred] Hands-on experience with technologies in the modern AI/LLM ecosystem, such as Databricks, Langchain, or MLFlow</li> <li>[Preferred] Advanced understanding of the probabilistic systems underpinning modern LLMs</li> <li>[Preferred] Experience building AI products in highly accuracy-sensitive domains such as finance is a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Our Values&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine.

You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit.

The opportunity

Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before.

The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like:

  • Where should the team focus its time and why?

  • How does outbound become consistently productive?

  • Where are deals getting stuck?

  • How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed?

  • Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities?

  • What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally?

  • How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on?

This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results.

What you’ll own

  • Sales strategy and execution

  • Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team

  • Outbound performance and pipeline generation

  • Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won

  • Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility

  • Performance management and clear expectations across the team

  • Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference

  • Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity

You’ll also stay close to customers and deals.

Stora wants a sales leader who knows what is happening on the ground, not someone whose understanding of the market comes entirely from dashboards and weekly reports.

What a strong candidate looks like

Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists.

You’re likely someone who:

  • Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands

  • Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them

  • Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly

  • Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed

  • Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline

  • Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities

  • Uses data to improve decisions without hiding behind dashboards

  • Challenges assumptions, spots where the sales motion is weak and acts on it

  • Sets clear expectations, coaches directly and holds people accountable

  • Can move comfortably between commercial strategy with the CEO, coaching the team and getting involved in a deal that matters

  • Has the commercial instinct to spot new segments, markets or opportunities worth pursuing

This is still a stage where leadership means building as well as leading. If you want to inherit a large sales organisation, established territories and a finished playbook, this probably is not the role.

Experience in vertical SaaS, operationally complex industries or international markets would be useful, but none are essential.

Why Stora

Stora builds the software self storage operators use to run and grow their businesses, covering areas including bookings, payments, facility management, reporting and automation.

The business has established strong traction in the UK and Ireland and is continuing to expand across Europe and other international markets.

For a Head of Sales, that creates an interesting point to join:

  • A proven product rather than an early experiment

  • Existing customers and market credibility

  • A sales team already in place

  • Significant European market opportunity ahead

  • Direct access to the CEO and leadership team

  • The ability to meaningfully shape commercial strategy

  • Share options and genuine participation in the upside created

The foundations exist. The opportunity is to build what comes next.

Location

Stora operates as a distributed business across the UK and Europe.

Being based in Northern Ireland would be particularly useful given the proximity to the CEO and leadership team, although strong candidates elsewhere in the UK or EU will absolutely be considered.

What Stora offers

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission plan

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • Apple hardware

  • Work from home budget

  • Learning and development support

  • Regular in-person team events and company meet-ups

Next steps

Applications are reviewed as they come in and Stora will move quickly where there is a strong fit.

Equal opportunities

Stora is committed to creating a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect.

Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment decisions are based on merit, capability and business need.

If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let the team know.

title: Corporate FP&A – Financial Planning
description: ABOUT CODEWAY We build and publish mobile apps that reach millions fast. We've built category-leading apps time and time again. A track record proven by hits like Cleanup (#1 iPhone storage cleaner worldwide), Retake AI (#1 AI face editing app in the US), and Learna AI (the top AI language learning app globally), alongside 50+ other apps across productivity, edtech, wellness, and entertainment, all shaping the future of consumer mobile. Since launching in 2020 with a small team in Istanbul, we've grown into a 300+ person global team. With over 400 million downloads and a worldwide footprint, we're already one of the fastest-growing consumer tech companies in Europe, and join us in our next big chapter. POSITION As our Corporate FP&A Analyst - Planning, you will report directly to the Director of FP&A and sit at the ultimate strategic clearinghouse of our finance function. As our portfolio scales globally, we are building a lean, world-class decision-support function from the ground up to evaluate complex strategic options, portfolio expansions, and capital deployment choices. You will sit at the corporate level, owning the master consolidation, corporate budget, and the underlying logic for individual app-level P&Ls. This is an AI-first, digital-native finance team. We communicate via active Slack channels, build out our operational blueprints and context sharing inside Notion, and run collaboration entirely through Google Workspace. You will leverage modern workflows—initially building and auditing multi-variable models in Microsoft Excel using the Claude for Excel add-in, with a direct, subsequent mandate to act as a core product stakeholder driving our platform migration to Pigment. KEY SKILLS To excel in this role, you must bring a sharp blend of institutional corporate finance discipline, modern data literacy, and a forward-looking technology stack: Strategic Architecture: Mastery of 3-statement long-range planning (LRP), rolling monthly forecasting , and corporate top-down / bottom-up budget reconciliation. Tactical Liquidity Control: Active management of short-term cash mechanics, specifically building 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts . Next-Gen Financial Stack: Advanced driver-based Excel modeling paired with prompt engineering ( Claude for Excel ) and multi-dimensional EPM exposure ( Pigment / Anaplan). Data & Ledger Awareness: Familiarity or exposure to data systems ( Looker / BI tools) and cloud ERP structures ( NetSuite ) to collaborate effectively on data alignment. Mobile Ecosystem Domain Expertise: Deep familiarity with B2C mobile metrics ( ROAS , LTV, CAC, and cohort curves) and institutional debt facility covenant tracking. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Own the Global Planning Cycle Engine & Budget Setting: Act as the architect and coordinator of Codeway’s global budget setting and forecasting process. You will build and own the corporate top-down strategic forecasting model and lead the continuous process of coordinating and consolidating the bottom-up inputs from the FBP network. You will design, establish, and push unified planning templates out to the FBPs, running a rigorous rolling monthly forecast to keep the global corporate model perfectly synchronised with live business pacing. You will partner closely with FBPs to challenge operational assumptions, extract key variables, and align strategic direction to fuel "The Engine." Enterprise Valuation & Long-Range Planning (LRP): Build and scale corporate three-statement models and integrated multi-year cash flow frameworks explicitly designed to evaluate macro strategic options, support capital structuring, and drive long-term corporate value creation. Tactility & Liquidity Control: Balance macro long-range planning with hyper-tactical operational control by owning, executing, and maintaining a tight, rolling 13-week cash flow forecast. Corporate UA Integration & Capital Pacing: Partner closely with our Corporate FP&A team members who own the portfolio UA allocation models. While they evaluate cohort dynamics across our apps to maximise ROAS, you will integrate their marketing deployment outputs into our central business plan, reconciling portfolio allocation shifts directly against corporate cash reserves and growth capital constraints. Growth Capital & Credit Facility Management: Direct the tracking, optimisation, and structural compliance of our institutional credit facility used to scale UA. Monitor global capital drawdowns, track funding velocity against strict covenant thresholds, and generate institutional-grade financial reporting for our lending partners. Multi-Dimensional Portfolio Cost Allocations: Architect and manage the cost allocation framework required to distribute centralised overhead (shared engineering, global data lakes, corporate G&A) down to individual app-level P&Ls to isolate and report true fully loaded unit economics. Advanced Scenario Modeling: Build dynamic, driver-based sensitivity models to instantly simulate shifting ecosystem dynamics and top-of-funnel marketing performance, cleanly integrating core growth metrics (ROAS, LTV, and CAC). Board Preparation & Headcount Alignment: Synthesise complex data into premium corporate narratives and visual decks for quarterly board reviews. Partner closely with the Talent Acquisition (TA) team to ensure global hiring plans and recruitment velocity reconcile perfectly with approved corporate budget constraints. System Integration & BI Collaboration: Support the connection between our corporate planning stack and underlying data environments. You will collaborate on projects to ensure financial actuals from NetSuite and core revenue performance/unit economics from Looker sync cleanly into our planning architecture (Excel/Claude → Pigment). WHAT YOU’LL BRING Experience: 3-6 years in Corporate FP&A, Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or Transaction Advisory within a high-growth B2C digital platform, mobile app company, or gaming studio. Dual-Speed Financial Fluency: Equal comfort building high-level strategic valuation structures (3-statement multi-year planning) and executing rapid, short-term liquidity controls. Elite Individual Contributor Profile: A high-autonomy operator who executes with urgency. You are highly proactive, you drive projects forward independently, and take immense pride in the technical integrity of your models. The Codeway Ethos: A natural self-starter who looks forward, not backward. You completely avoid an audit or ledger-heavy mindset; you treat finance as an agile, value-generating growth partner, and possess the conviction to challenge leadership constructively in a founder-led culture. Collaborative Matrix Skills: Strong foundational background in corporate consolidation and recurring planning windows. You excel at extracting variables from decentralised partners, using high-impact communication to pressure-test assumptions and seamlessly turn operational data into continuous rolling monthly forecasts. Mobile Ecosystem Domain Expertise: Deep operational understanding of app store economics, subscription models, digital revenue dynamics, and core growth tracking metrics—specifically ROAS, LTV, and CAC. Next-Gen Technical Profile: You treat prompt engineering as a core finance capability, with hands-on experience or immediate adaptability to LLM add-in layers (Claude for Excel). Systems & Data Literacy: Comfortable navigating Looker (or equivalent BI platforms) to view or cross-check revenue performance and tracking data frameworks within NetSuite. Exposure to multi-dimensional EPM tools (Pigment, Anaplan, or Workday Adaptive) is a major plus. WHAT WE OFFER Flexible Career Trajectory: We are looking for an exceptional builder. If leadership is your goal and you demonstrate the capability, this role is positioned on a direct track to step up and lead the Corporate FP&A team. Alternatively, if your passion lies in pure execution, you have the option to remain as a principal individual contributor driving global architecture. Scale & Impact: The rare opportunity to shape the central financial architecture of a profitable, self-funded scale-up ($400M+ ARR) right at its inception. Culture: An energetic, high-performance environment where finance is treated as an aggressive value-generator rather than administrative overhead. Relocation support available if you decide to move to Barcelona. Full-time contract with competitive salary Private health insurance Full visa & relocation support if you’re moving to Barcelona Annual learning & development budget for courses, tools, or events that support your growth Wellness perks, including sports budget and psychological consultations.
